name: PDF demo company policy
assumptions: Applies to selected demo purchase cases, not every bank movement.
Strict receipt deadline is a company rule, not a universal IRS requirement.
A later approval cannot establish pre-approval for a posted purchase.

fix.description: Obtain authorized approval before purchase. For a posted purchase, escalate the historical violation; do not backdate approval.

rules.text: Intern rideshare and airfare purchases are permitted only for company events.

fix.description: Provide evidence of an actual company event, or choose an eligible purchase. Do not change the factual purpose.

rules.text: When a receipt is required, submit it within 60 days of purchase. After day 60, evidence of timely submission is required.

fix.description: Supply an existing receipt submission record dated within 60 days, or escalate a late submission. Uploading today cannot erase a missed deadline.
